title: Fix the bulk discount boundary
issue: The pricing module says that 10 items or more qualify for the bulk discount, but `qualifiesForBulkDiscount` uses a strict greater-than comparison. Fix the boundary without weakening the existing tests. Quantities must remain non-negative integers.
expectedBehavior: qualifiesForBulkDiscount returns false below 10 items and true for 10 items or more, while rejecting negative, fractional, and non-numeric quantities with TypeError.
